controls.procedure: Compare the exact current material SHA and base with the workflow subject before accepting any completed gate as current evidence.
controls.expected: Only completed evidence whose subject is the current material candidate can support handoff readiness.
controls.observed: Validate PR run 7202 attempt 2 completed successfully with head c7d37eb and base develop@be578b5.

controls.procedure: Force mutation success followed by list refresh failure for create, update, delete and rename, then inspect user-visible status and mutation counts.
controls.expected: Refresh failure remains visible, success is suppressed, and recovery does not replay the mutation.
controls.observed: The exact-head parameter regression suite is included in run 7202 and retains create/update/delete/rename refresh-failure coverage.

controls.procedure: Classify every repository write after a published handoff and invalidate the certificate whenever a non-result path changes.
controls.expected: Any material write after handoff forces post-write-refreeze before another audit or release claim.
controls.observed: The prior d9f75a7 handoff was rejected after later browser-evidence test commits; this remediation freezes c7d37eb as the new material head.

controls.procedure: Immediately before the delivery response, re-read the remote branch head and compare it with the published result-only child plus the complete post-publication changed-path delta.
controls.expected: No delivery may be handed to independent audit when the current remote head moved beyond the published handoff or contains a later material path.
controls.observed: The current remediation protocol requires a fresh remote identity read after publication and blocks if current_head differs from the terminal child; terminal verification is performed after the new commit is published.

retired_controls.reason: The historical target-binding identifier remains preserved while the active truthfulness control verifies the current target and exact workflow subject on every refreeze.
retired_controls.procedure: Preserve the historical control identifier and use the active exact-head replacement for the current delivery target.
retired_controls.expected: Historical lineage remains explicit and a passed exact-head replacement continues to enforce the target boundary.
retired_controls.observed: The retired identifier remains cumulative and ISSUE367-HANDOFF-TRUTHFULNESS passed against the current material head.
